name: The Story of Angel
overview: Follows the rise of Angel Studios, from its early days as a small startup to a studio disrupting the entertainment industry. Through lawsuits, crowdfunding, the launch of The Chosen, theatrical releases, and the creation of the Guild, the series shows the risks, failures, and breakthroughs that nearly ended the company—and the moments that changed everything.
